page.notes: The scan is small and the Greek is hard to read in places; the Greek passages are the most likely to contain errors and are not checked letter by letter. The small-type annotations sit inside the column and are transcribed as running text. A stray mark at the bottom left (a dot and a small stroke) is ignored as not printed text. The last line "cebant," stands alone at the right and is taken as the completion of "exer-", so it is not treated as a catchword.
